body:
**What I did:**
Retested on Staging on 2026-10-14. Sequence Email is Opened in Saleshandy trigger, Update a Deal in HubSpot activity, with Extra Configuration set to Pipeline: Sales Pipeline, Pipeline Stage: Follow-Up, Deal Type: New Business, Deal Priority: High, Closing Date: 0 Days.

**Steps:**
1. Enable only the trigger with the Update a Deal in HubSpot activity (paired with Create a Note or Record (log) an Email Activity where noted), fill in Extra Configuration and save.
2. Create the contact in HubSpot with its deal or deals (the deal names are not the prospect's email).
3. Add the same prospect to a sequence, wait for the step 1 email to be sent, and open it.
4. Open API & Integrations > Integrations > HubSpot > Logs, check the workflow status, then check the deal in HubSpot.

| # | Scenario | Actual Result | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Contact has 1 deal | Workflow Success, the deal shows Pipeline Stage Follow-Up, Deal Type New Business, Deal Priority High | Pass |
| 2 | Contact has 3 deals | Workflow Success, the latest created deal is updated | Pass |
| 3 | Extra Configuration values changed, same email opened again | New log entry Success, the deal shows the new values | Pass |
| 4 | Closing Date 51 Days | Workflow Success, Close Date is today + 51 days | Pass |
| 5 | Paired with Create a Note, contact has 1 deal | Workflow Success, deal updated, the note is on both the contact and the deal | Pass, working as intended |
| 6 | Paired with Record (log) an Email Activity, contact has 3 deals | Workflow Success, latest deal updated, email logged on that deal, card reads "Logged email by Email Opened via Saleshandy" | Pass, working as intended |

**Note:** I could not reproduce the issue on this ticket. In the log's execution detail the Search deal step now filters by the contact and finds the deal; on 2026-10-13 it filtered by deal name equal to the prospect's email and found none. The Update a Deal scenarios passed in two separate runs on 2026-10-14. Scenario 5 is working as intended: the contact and the deal both receive the note (confirmed with the developer).
waitingFor: QA to check the wording: it says 'could not reproduce', not 'fixed', because no fix was reported to me. Evidence: automation/test-results-emailopened-al4128-retest/ and test-results-emailopened-deals-rerun/.
